title: 知道接下来会发生什么，安排事情就有了底

interpretations.headline: 知道接下来会发生什么，安排事情就有了底
interpretations.scoreLabel: 工作可预期性（0–100 分均分）
interpretations.summary:
知道周一流程会变，和知道新的做法、时间点以及遇到问题找谁，带来的准备程度不同。提前收到消息和拿到足够资料，是两种可以分别改善的工作条件。

Knowing a process will change on Monday tells you less than knowing the timing, instructions and contact person. The two items address early notice and access to the information needed for work.

guidance.text:
选一次让计划被打乱的变动，区分是通知太晚，还是资料不齐。下一次给同类变动设一个明确通知节点。

Think of a change that interrupted your plans. Was there too little notice, or was necessary information hard to find? Agree on one point for notifying people next time.

limitations: 本维度由 2 个附录原项构成。各题按 0、25、50、75 或 100 计分，同权求均分。系统仅在答全时计算，未完成的答卷没有该分数。
得分越高，表示作答者越容易提前获知变化，也较容易拿到工作所需资料。结果描述本次作答。可用证据限于该维度相关国际中版研究，项目不套用地方常模、风险分级和个人能力评级。

English items and the five response options come unchanged from Annex 1. This descriptive score is the mean of completed items when all items are answered. Higher scores indicate more of the characteristic named by the scale. Formal risk assessment and clinical interpretation require separate information.
report.disclaimer: 用于成年工作人群的非商业研究和自我回顾。请结合具体情境理解。 For non-commercial research with adult workers and personal reflection.
